verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows LiveKit Agents itself being operated or configured through natural-language commands. The voice agents developers build do converse in natural language, but that is the output of the framework, not a way to operate it. Agent Builder is described only as no-code browser prototyping, not natural-language control. The 'built for coding agents like Claude Code' note and llms.txt are external tools and doc building blocks, which earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
